Container.Name: react-torrent
Container.Overview: Self-hosted web UI for qBittorrent. The container serves the page and is the only thing that talks to qBittorrent. Runs as 99:100 with a read-only filesystem; settings live in /config.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port the browser uses at home. APP_ORIGINS must use the same port.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: settings.json lives here. Create the folder and chown 99:100 first.

Config.Name: QBIT_URL
Config.Description: qBittorrent WebUI as seen from inside this container: http://NAS-address:qBittorrent-host-port (container names do not resolve on bridge). See docs/deployment.md.

Config.Name: QBIT_USERNAME
Config.Description: qBittorrent WebUI username. Also the login for this app.

Config.Name: QBIT_PASSWORD
Config.Description: qBittorrent WebUI password. Also the login for this app.

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Output of openssl rand -base64 32. Changing it logs every device out.

Config.Name: APP_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Comma-separated addresses the browser uses, no trailing slash, e.g. http://nas.example:3000,https://torrent.example.com

Config.Name: SAVE_ROOTS
Config.Description: Comma-separated download roots as seen inside the qBittorrent container, e.g. /downloads
